meta.title: Brutti caption style
meta.source: META_POST_INSIGHTS, read-only. 7,198 captions with text, 3,544 Facebook and 3,654 Instagram, 11 Oct 2020–18 Nov 2026.
meta.target: Use the 2025–2026 product-post shape, in the same casual Sabah voice Brutti has used since 2020. Content Studio still writes 4–5 short lines and omits hashtags; Berlys can add the hashtag set below.
meta.notes: Figures and quotes come from the live posts. Prices in this file are written as RM… unless a pattern needs a public caption example. Phone numbers are not stored. Client and artisan names are not copied into templates.

voice.language: About 80% Bahasa Malaysia, 11% English, 2% mixed. Facebook and Instagram use almost the same voice; many posts are cross-posted.
voice.sabah: About 1 in 4 captions use Sabah markers (ni, nda, ja, kan, ngam, mau, kasi, bikin, pigi, sudah, kitani). Stronger in 2020–2021 (~32%), still common now (~22–26%).
voice.person: First person kami / team Brutti; talk to the reader as kamu. Light humour, like a friend, not a catalogue.

eras.shape: Short and casual, median 4–5 lines and ~200–285 characters. Almost no hashtags. More Sabah dialect. Hooks are everyday jokes or a short scene.
Still fairly short (median 4 lines). Hashtags begin, often place and custom-made tags (#penampang, #kotakinabalu, #custommade, #kkcity).
The core Brutti hashtag set appears. Median still 4 lines / ~344 characters.

Current house style for product posts: longer (median 8 lines, 500–680 characters), emoji on most posts, a Product Details block when size/material/price is stated, and the core hashtag set after the caption. Content Studio keeps a tighter 4–5 line body and attaches the same Product Details list when those fields are filled.

structure.line1: Short hook, median 31 characters: a question, a tease, a short scene with an emoji, or in live posts sometimes the product name plus ✨ on its own line. Content Studio should open on a hook, not the bare product name.
structure.body: Short lines, one thought each. Blank line or a lone '.' is used as a pause in live posts. Tell one scene: who it is for, what the piece does, one real fact.
structure.details:
From 2025, many product posts end with:
Product Details:
• Size: …
• Materials: …
• Finishing: …
• Price starts from RM…
Only include a line when that fact was provided. Never invent a price, size, material or finishing. The app already appends this block.
structure.length_studio: 4 or 5 short body lines, then Product Details if facts exist. No hashtags in the generated caption.
structure.platforms: Write Facebook and Instagram as two different captions with the same facts. TikTok, if used, is shorter and must not mention analytics.

patterns.how: A short question that a customer would actually ask.
A short line that ends with ✨ 😍 🤭 or 😆.
A tease or open loop, under about 12 words.
Behind the scene / Part N, for process or workshop stories only. Do not invent a founder story.

openers: Do you still remember this piece? 🤭
Kamu nda pasti cara mau pasang?
Kalau tinguk sekali nampak biasa ja kan

emoji.studio_rule: One or two emoji, at the end of a line, not in a row of four. Prefer ✨ 😍 😆 🤭 🤣 ❤️ 👀.

hashtagSets.studio: Do not auto-insert hashtags. Live posts put them after the caption. Berlys can paste a set if needed.
hashtagSets.note: Live posts often use #kotakinablu (a long-running typo, 2,381 times). Prefer #kotakinabalu on new captions.

cta.what_the_posts_do: WhatsApp is rare (0.6% of captions). DM/inbox is uncommon (1.4%). Location or showroom is mentioned in about 24%. Order/tempah appears in about 7%. A frequent soft close is 'Hanya di Brutti' or 'kalau kamu mau…'.
cta.studio: Do not add a WhatsApp number, DM, or inbox line unless the user wrote it in the note. Prefer a soft close.
variants: Kalau kamu mau piece ikut ruang kamu, cerita je pada kami.
Jangan lupa, piece ni custom ikut kamu.

products.how: Say the product name once, in title case, in the body. Materials show up in about half of all posts; size and price are less common (~7% and ~6%) but rise in 2025–2026. Put size, material, finishing and price in Product Details, not in every sentence. Only use numbers the user (or the product library) actually gave.
products.from_studio_fields: The Note and the Product details checklist (Dimensions, Materials & Finishing, Price, plus any row the user adds) are real facts. If a box is empty or unticked, skip it.

highlight.aim: One hook, one reason the piece fits the space, one real detail, then Product Details if facts exist.
openers: Banyak juga yang suka piece ni kan? 🤭
Ruang kecil, piece biasa tidak muat kan? ✨

promo.aim: Only mention a price, stock or offer if the user wrote it. Never invent 'ready stock', 'only 1 left', or a discount.

customer.aim: Thank the client in general terms. Do not invent a client name, artisan name, or private story.
openers: Ada ruang yang piece biasa tidak muat. ✨
Terima kasih sebab percaya kerja tangan sini.

behind.aim: Workshop or process only. Do not paste founder biography, health, or pandemic stories into a product caption.

tips.aim: One practical tip tied to the product or topic. No invented measurements.
openers: Kamu nda pasti cara mau susun?
Mula dari barang yang kamu guna setiap hari. ✨

topPerforming.what_differs: The top 5% of posts (by engagement, among posts with reach of 200 or more) are 94% BM, slightly more likely to open as a short hook or a 'Part N / behind the scene' story, and a bit less likely to be a long English product list. High-reach posts include product reveals, workshop stories, events such as Tamu Dulu-Dulu, and occasional community stories. Product captions that do well still start short, stay in BM, and name one clear benefit (for example a table that extends for a family gathering).
topPerforming.do_not_copy: Do not reuse private or community-crisis stories, voting posts, or medical stories as product templates.

do: Write in casual Bahasa Malaysia, with light Sabah flavour (ni, ngam, ja, kan, mau, kasi, bikin).
Open on a short hook: a question, a tease, or a one-line scene with a single emoji.
Name the product once, in title case, in the body.
Keep body lines short, 4 or 5 of them, one thought per line.
Put size, material, finishing and price only in Product Details, and only when the user or the library supplied them.
Use one or two emoji at the end of a line (✨ 😍 😆 🤭).
Close softly (Hanya di Brutti / kalau kamu mau…) unless the user gave another CTA.
Keep Facebook and Instagram different, with the same real facts.
dont: Do not invent prices, sizes, materials, colours, stock, discounts, dates, artisan names or client names.
Do not open with POV or with the product name alone on line 1.
Do not use bah, nak, mahu, or stiff words such as diperbuat daripada, reka bentuk, bersama, selepas.
Do not put hashtags in the generated caption (they belong after the caption, added by a person).
Do not add a WhatsApp number or a DM line unless the user wrote it.
Do not copy a whole old caption, and do not move another post's facts onto this product.
Do not paste founder biography, health stories, or community-crisis stories into a product caption.
Do not mention analytics, views or reach.
